categories.main_business_segments: RS Technologies operates four main business segments: Wafer Reclaim (recycling and sales of silicon wafers), Prime Silicon Wafer Manufacturing and Sales, Semiconductor-related Equipment and Materials (including sales of semiconductor equipment, consumables, and automotive camera modules), and Other (solar power generation and technical consulting). The company has also recently entered the renewable energy and automotive camera module businesses through new subsidiaries and acquisitions.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company's core technologies include advanced silicon wafer reclaim processes (stripping, etching, polishing, multi-stage cleaning, and inspection), prime wafer crystal growth and processing, and thin film oxidation services. It emphasizes high-yield, high-quality wafer processing, microfabrication for advanced semiconductor nodes, and continuous improvement of production efficiency and automation. R&D focuses on crystal technology for 8-inch wafers, advanced 12-inch wafer reclaim, and mass production stabilization for new business lines.
categories.primary_customers_markets: RS Technologies primarily serves global semiconductor device manufacturers, including major foundries such as TSMC. Its customers are mainly in the semiconductor industry, with end markets spanning automotive, medical, environmental, smart home, smart city, data centers, M2M, IoT, and AI applications. The company also supplies equipment and materials to semiconductor manufacturers and related industries.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally, with key production and sales bases in Japan, Taiwan, and China, and significant sales in Korea, the US, Europe, and Southeast Asia. Major manufacturing facilities are located in Japan (Miyagi), Taiwan (Tainan), and China (Beijing, Shandong, Huizhou). Sales are diversified across Asia, North America, and Europe.
categories.supply_chain_position: RS Technologies is positioned both upstream and midstream in the semiconductor supply chain. It supplies reclaimed and prime silicon wafers as substrates for semiconductor manufacturing (upstream/midstream), and also provides equipment, consumables, and technical services to device manufacturers (midstream).
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding global market share in 8-inch and 12-inch wafer segments, advancing microfabrication and crystal growth technologies, and strengthening production automation and efficiency. The company is investing in R&D for high-yield, high-quality wafer processing, mass production of advanced wafers, and new business areas such as renewable energy and automotive camera modules. It also emphasizes sustainability, climate risk management, and workforce diversity.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through the sale of reclaimed and prime silicon wafers, semiconductor equipment and consumables, and related services. Additional revenue streams include solar power generation (electricity sales), technical consulting, and, more recently, automotive camera module manufacturing and sales. Revenue is recognized upon delivery or completion of services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: RS Technologies operates in a highly competitive global semiconductor materials market, facing competition from both domestic and international wafer manufacturers and reclaimers. The company holds a strong position in the wafer reclaim segment, with high market share and global customer relationships, particularly with leading foundries. It differentiates itself through technology, quality, and global supply capabilities.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ending December 2024, consolidated sales reached ¥59.2 billion (up 14.1% YoY), with operating profit of ¥13.1 billion and net profit attributable to parent shareholders of ¥9.4 billion (up 22.6% YoY). Total assets were ¥182.1 billion, and the company employed 2,614 people. The company has demonstrated strong growth in sales and profits over the past five years, driven by capacity expansion, overseas growth, and diversification.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: RS Technologies emphasizes high-quality, cost-effective wafer reclaim services that enable semiconductor manufacturers to reduce costs and environmental impact while maintaining performance. Its global production network, advanced microfabrication and crystal technologies, and ability to serve leading-edge and high-volume customers set it apart. The company also highlights its commitment to sustainability, stable supply, and responsiveness to evolving semiconductor industry needs.
